title: Precision stop · Level 3: A moving start, a wider angle
brief: As level 2, from starts turned up to 6 degrees. The distance sensor's doubled noise comes with DIST: until then this level runs on the normal sensor, as practice. Par: E = 10 mm.

score.run: if(stopped & touches == 0 & visitTime_1 >= 0 & visitTime_2 > visitTime_1 & 200 / (visitTime_2 - visitTime_1) >= trapMms, round(max(0, 100 - 5 * abs((wall - (endX + bodyFront * cosd(endHeading) + bodyHalf * abs(sind(endHeading)))) - target)), 1), 0)

stops.value: count(r in runs: r.stopped & r.touches == 0 & r.visitTime_1 >= 0 & r.visitTime_2 > r.visitTime_1 & 200 / (r.visitTime_2 - r.visitTime_1) >= trapMms)

bias.value: if(stops > 0, sum(r in runs: if(r.stopped & r.touches == 0 & r.visitTime_1 >= 0 & r.visitTime_2 > r.visitTime_1 & 200 / (r.visitTime_2 - r.visitTime_1) >= trapMms, (wall - (r.endX + r.bodyFront * cosd(r.endHeading) + r.bodyHalf * abs(sind(r.endHeading)))) - target, 0)) / stops, 0)

spread.value: if(stops > 1, sqrt(sum(r in runs: if(r.stopped & r.touches == 0 & r.visitTime_1 >= 0 & r.visitTime_2 > r.visitTime_1 & 200 / (r.visitTime_2 - r.visitTime_1) >= trapMms, ((wall - (r.endX + r.bodyFront * cosd(r.endHeading) + r.bodyHalf * abs(sind(r.endHeading)))) - target - bias) ^ 2, 0)) / (stops - 1)), 0)

sources.where: G7.1 Precision stop, the challenge paragraph and the level table (level 3)
§10 (the still end, runEnd, batch scoring), §11.3 (visits: the speed trap), §13 (robot and start rules)
